how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to inform planning and investment decisions by showing the existing and potential distribution of commuter and school cycle trips, helping to identify areas for appropriate investment and to test the emerging network against modelled scenarios.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process has directly influenced the development of a proposed network of cycling and walking routes, informed the prioritisation of infrastructure improvements, and is being used by West Sussex County Council to develop business cases for routes that connect places.
pct_usage_quote: The aim of the PCT is to inform planning and investment decisions for cycling infrastructure by showing the existing and potential distribution of commuter cycle trips and therefore inform which investment locations could represent best value for money.
